coordinates: Metres in the standard YAM station: x forward, y left, z up.

wheel.rim_material: aluminium, nominal E=69 GPa; hollow section response uncalibrated
wheel.nipples: Brass, 12 mm total length: 6 mm square flats of 3.23 mm width, followed by a 6 mm barrel of 3 mm diameter into the rim bearing. Flat centre is 16 mm inward from the rim centreline along the spoke; nominal thread pitch 0.454 mm.
wheel.reset_note: Nipples0 and2 are0.75turn loose relative to the nominal700N reference; other offsets zero. Spoke0 starts at the bottom. The native0.3s settling check yields0.889mm runout and190–647N tension, so the start earns zero. Engineering fixture, not calibrated commercial-wheel data.

robot_plan_candidate.note: Explicit diagnostic layout only; default scene clocking and flat phase remain zero.

axle_geometry.note: Front end x=.315, rear end x=.415; fixed far-side truing stand clamps the rear end.

stand.attachment: Single-sided cantilever stand bolted to table, clamping the far axle end at x=.415m. Hub remains free on bearings; no active brake or wheel attachment to the robot.
stand.pointer: Steel20×2×2mm pointer beside bottom rim; gap measured with feeler gauges. No initial rim contact.

wrench.material: Steel jaw and 175 mm neck, steel tang inside polymer grip
wrench.start: Lying flat, slot centre at (0.20, -0.005, 0.7555) m and mouth toward +y; free from robot and nipple.
